episode_row: shadow-report mislabelled DD-aware rate as "Production P@1"

commits.subject: fix(shadow-report): rename "Production P@1" label to accurate "day hit rate"
commits.body:
The shadow_report CLI was displaying "Production P@1" but the underlying
computation counts days where prod.result == "hit", which is the
double-down-aware DAY-LEVEL result — not top-1 P@1. On 2026-04-11 both
models picked the same batters (Arraez + Kwan), Arraez hit and Kwan
missed, so true top-1 P@1 = 1 but day result = miss. The display read
"Production P@1: 1/5" when it actually meant "1 of 5 days had both
picks hit" (real top-1 P@1 over that window is 2/5).

Renames the label to "Production day hit rate (DD-aware)" and updates
the docstring. Math unchanged.
